metadata.description: Project-specific labelled semantic reference and evaluation benchmark for AI-assisted Dark Pattern Detection (Forced Action & Basket Sneaking)
metadata.project: Intelligent Automated Compliance Auditing Framework / Dark Pattern Compliance Auditor
metadata.model_attribution: The base language representation uses the pretrained Sentence Transformer model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). The project does not claim to train the base model.
metadata.evaluation_disclaimer: The evaluation dataset is project-specific and relatively small (38 samples); results demonstrate functional validation rather than broad statistical generalization.
